$tournamentId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['code', 'name', 'mode', 'level', 'status', 'host', 'createdAt']) && newData.child('code').isString() && newData.child('code').val().length == 6 && newData.child('code').val() == $tournamentId && newData.child('name').isString() && newData.child('name').val().length <= 50 && newData.child('mode').val().matches(/^(groups|knockout)$/) && newData.child('level').val().matches(/^(easy|medium|hard|master)$/) && newData.child('status').val().matches(/^(lobby|groups|knockout|finished)$/) && newData.child('host').isString() && (!newData.hasChild('pointsToWin') || (newData.child('pointsToWin').isNumber() && newData.child('pointsToWin').val() >= 1 && newData.child('pointsToWin').val() <= 10)) && (!newData.hasChild('groupCount') || (newData.child('groupCount').isNumber() && newData.child('groupCount').val() >= 0 && newData.child('groupCount').val() <= 8))
